M012 [3.2.2 Manifest Entries] (2) `preview_of` | string | OPTIONAL | The `urn` of another entry **in the same Manifest** for which this entry is a reduced-fidelity preview (MEP-002). A violating member is **ignored** at ingest validation (the entry otherwise stands).
